transcript.statement: The requirements I propose focus on enhancing the sustainability of the bookkeeping system. GRN-01 ensures energy efficiency by using optimized algorithms, while GRN-02 promotes cloud-based solutions to lessen our carbon footprint. GRN-03 significantly reduces paper usage through document digitization. GRN-04 tracks resource impacts, allowing for continuous improvement. GRN-05 provides users with essential sustainability metrics. GRN-06 empowers users to offset their carbon emissions, and GRN-07 ensures compliance with sustainability regulations. Together, these requirements make the system environmentally responsible and align with global sustainability goals.
